tasks.name: Long-horizon setup and architecture investigation
tasks.prompt: Prepare a decision-ready technical investigation for a new Mac user who wants to set up https://github.com/swaymun/steve with their own Codex agent. Read the current public README and setup guide, then independently verify prerequisites against current primary documentation. Investigate: Codex ChatGPT sign-in and app-server; official desktop Computer Use requirements; macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording grants; Tailscale CLI login and private Serve versus public Funnel; 1Password-assisted browser login without putting passwords in an iMessage or model transcript; and source-build installation/update limitations. Also produce a concise onboarding-checklist.md. Separate verified capabilities from proposals and unknowns. Do not change the repo, accounts, installs, or permissions. All6 investigation topics addressed
